title: Zesty Roasted Canadian Raspberry Pancakes
description: A delicious and healthy Canadian brunch dish featuring roasted raspberries and a zesty twist, made with a mother-sauce-base and low-calorie-friendly ingredients. This recipe is perfect for a weekend brunch or a special occasion.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, salt, and sugar.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs, milk, and melted butter.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
Gently fold in the roasted raspberries.
Heat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat.
Drop the batter by 1/4 cupfuls onto the skillet or griddle.
Cook the pancakes for 2-3 minutes, until bubbles appear on the surface and the edges start to dry.
Flip the pancakes and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until golden brown.
